label: prop:categorical-self-duality
title: Categorical self-duality
html:
Let (\mathbf{C}, A, \tau) be a quantum observable universe. Every connection \nabla that is a critical point of the categorical Yang--Mills functional

  S[\nabla] =  \int_A\!\bigl(\star_q(F_\nabla) \cdot F_\nabla\bigr)

is an instanton.

The argument is the Bogomolny decomposition, given in the proof below. The Lean backing QOU.categorical_self_duality does not carry it: it is a structural accessor for the self_dual field of CategoricalInstanton, so it records that an object of that structure satisfies the condition the structure imposes, not that a critical point of S[\nabla] is such an object. The implication above is established in narrative here and is not formalised.
heading: Proposition
